observations: Three photos show two identical black laptop cooling fans placed side by side on a wooden surface.
Each fan has a circular frame with a central label reading 'FCN BRUSHLESS MOTOR', 'MADE IN CHINA', and certification marks (CE, UL).
The left fan has a model label: 'DFS551205VCO7 EP', 'DC 5V 0.5A', 'OFKMV0000H'.
The right fan has a model label: 'DFS2001053E07 EP', 'DC 5V 0.5A', 'OFKMV0000H'.
Both fans have four-wire connectors with black tape wrapped around the base.
The fans appear to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear.
A watermark 'CORNERSTONE INFORMATION' is visible across all photos.
No Razer branding or model identifiers are visible on the fans themselves.
